annotations.text:
Flow: Games → Chess menu → New game (level + side) → Play → Game over.
Learn Openings → list → walkthrough.

Play board: side buttons Up/Down, front ◀ ▶ move cursor; Confirm selects a piece (dots = legal squares, ring = capture) then confirms the move. Engine reply here is a random capture-first stand-in, real firmware uses alpha-beta.
480×800 1-bit e-ink. Dark squares = 25% dither like Sudoku fixed cells. Cursor = 3 px border (Sudoku idiom). Header, list rows, button hint boxes copied from Foulad theme metrics.
